title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12826__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 2 ) covers the various parameters that shall form part of the supplier's tender documents for the supply of industrial furnaces ordered by the purchaser in accordance with Part 1 of this standard.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of terms relating to fuel fired industrial furnaces
Chemically-Bonded Magnesite-Chrome Refractories for General Purposes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
